title: I made a presidential simulator where governing gets in the way of golfing. Yes, that's Trump's voice.
author: Junior_Muffin5931
selftext: I've been developing a satirical incremental game called President of the Office (PTO), where you become president and try to survive the job without getting impeached. You have to manage Political Capital, appoint staff, handle presidential responsibilities, and somehow find time to improve your golf game. I've been using AI-assisted development with ChatGPT and Claude, directing the design, gameplay mechanics, and balancing while iterating on the implementation and testing. The video shows some early gameplay, complete with an AI-generated Trump voiceover because I couldn't think of anyone more appropriate. It's still in development, but I figured some of you might get a laugh out of it. I'd be interested in feedback on the gameplay loop.

comments.author: Hotwingz66
comments.body:
Fun but he sounds a bit too coherent.

You really got me in the beginning but the illusion breaks when he is able to string sentences and instructions together.

That's too uncanny even for me.
